Name: Silver's New Aviary
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I wasn't happy with my old aviary. It was buggy and kinda ugly. Now that I have a bit more art and Tiled experience under my belt, I thought I'd bring a whole new aviary to the game!

The indoor map of this aviary is a modified version of bobkalonger's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33727]Gigantic Coop and Barn[/url], which has open permissions. It can be purchased at Robin's for 50,000g, 800 pieces of wood, 600 pieces of stone, and 100 pieces of hardwood. The aviary features a natural, foresty feel to it. It can house up to 50 animals, and the coolest bit: you can have both barn and coop animals in it! The idea was to have a unified spot for all your bird and bird-like creatures, though of course you can put any animal you want in it. It features an auto-feeder, 3 regular incubators and 1 ostrich incubator. It even has a pond for your little swimming fellows! It should be compatible with any recolors on the inside, and there's a config to make the exterior white or wooden and desaturated to go with recolors like Earthy.

***Original building too big for your farm? Try the optional TARDIS version! Exterior is much smaller but it's bigger on the inside!

Enjoy!
